title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook and quality gating improvements
author: Jordan Patel
release_notes: Add per-prompt CI hook to run eval harness on changed prompt sets; tighten quality gating thresholds and expose per-prompt signal in CI. Backwards compatible with existing eval jobs.
description: Motivation: several recent regressions slipped through general evaluation because our CI aggregated metrics masked per-prompt failures. This PR adds a per-prompt regression hook for the eval-harness and tightens quality gating to fail CI when individual prompt-set regressions exceed threshold. Changes include a lightweight per-prompt runner that can be invoked only for modified prompt files, an opt-in stricter gating profile for release branches, and instrumentation to surface per-prompt metrics in the existing CI artifacts. Checklist: - [x] implement per-prompt CI runner and hook - [x] add gating profiles and thresholds - [x] update CI pipeline to call new hook when prompt files change - [x] add tests and unit coverage - [x] update docs and runbook Links: linear/ENG-1023, SUP ticket SUP-4421. Note: this is non-breaking for consumers, default gating remains unchanged on main until the stricter profile is enabled on release/*.

notes: This reduces noise from aggregate metrics and enables targeted rollbacks if a single prompt set causes quality regressions. Ops runbook updated to include steps for toggling release_strict gating and interpreting per-prompt artifacts.
